decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is a niche option with unresolved demand uncertainty and low cost to keep, so we retain it.
Explosion-proof luminaires fit our industrial focus and the new LED replacement kit shows value is being realized, making drop unlikely.
The relaunch of a popular designer task light signals proven demand, and the cost of keeping this option open is modest.
Pendant office luminaires are core to our building lighting portfolio, and uncertainty about their eventual value still justifies keeping the option.
The premium pendant luminaire has higher uncertainty but aligns with our quality positioning, so we keep the option as a relatively low-cost bet.
